description: This file contains helper functions used to facilitate interactive rebase testing in a Git environment, including setting fake editors, verifying rebase sequences, and managing commit rewording.

methods.name: set_fake_editor
methods.description: Sets up a fake editor script to simulate editing commit messages and rebase scripts for testing.

methods.name: set_cat_todo_editor
methods.description: Sets up an editor to output only the rebase todo list for verification purposes.

methods.name: test_linear_range
methods.description: Verifies that the commit revisions form a linear range with the specified subject list.

methods.name: reset_rebase
methods.description: Aborts any ongoing rebase, resets the repository to a clean state.

methods.name: cherry_pick
methods.description: Performs a cherry-pick of a specific commit with a message and tags the result.

methods.name: revert
methods.description: Reverts a specific commit and tags the result.

methods.name: make_empty
methods.description: Creates an empty commit with a message and tags it.

methods.name: test_editor_unchanged
methods.description: Checks that environment variables related to editors remain unchanged after a test.

methods.name: set_reword_editor
methods.description: Configures an editor for testing commit rewording and tracks reworded commits.

methods.name: check_reworded_commits
methods.description: Verifies that commits were correctly reworded and the rebase behavior matched expectations.

methods.name: set_replace_editor
methods.description: Replaces the rebase todo list with specific contents for testing.
